Class UpdateHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.network.UpdateHandler
public class UpdateHandler extends Object
The UpdateHandler class provides static methods to manage and dispatch game updates to connected clients. It handles various scenarios related to drawing cards and resolving card effects, ensuring that clients receive the correct information and turn changes.

  • Method Details

    • drawCardTurnHandler

      public static boolean drawCardTurnHandler(Card card, Controller controller, Map<UUID,ClientData> clients, Map<UUID,ClientData> passiveClients, Game model, AsyncRunner dispatcher) throws Exception
      Handles the turn logic after a card has been drawn. This method dictates later actions based on the type of card drawn, such as updating positions, changing turns.
      Parameters:
      card - The Card that was drawn.
      controller - The game Controller instance.
      clients - A map of active client UUIDs to their ClientData.
      passiveClients - A map of passive client UUIDs to their ClientData.
      model - The current Game model.
      dispatcher - The AsyncRunner used for asynchronous task execution to clients.
      Returns:
      true if the turn handling logic concludes successfully and the turn can proceed, false if the current player's turn needs to be passed.
      Throws:
      Exception - If an error occurs during client communication or model manipulation.

    • effectContextTurnHandler

      public static void effectContextTurnHandler(UUID clientId, int res, Map<UUID,ClientData> clients, Map<UUID,ClientData> passiveClients, Game model, AsyncRunner dispatcher) throws Exception
      Handles turn logic based on the resolution of a card effect context. This method dispatches specific updates to clients depending on the current card type and the result of the effect. This includes updating ship positions, showing ships, and managing turn changes.
      Parameters:
      clientId - The UUID of the client whose effect context is being resolved.
      res - An integer representing the result or choice made during the effect resolution.
      clients - A map of active client UUIDs to their ClientData.
      passiveClients - A map of passive client UUIDs to their ClientData.
      model - The current Game model.
      dispatcher - The AsyncRunner used for asynchronous task execution to clients.
      Throws:
      Exception - If an error occurs during client communication or model manipulation.

    • newLeader

      public static void newLeader(Map<UUID,ClientData> activeClients, Map<UUID,ClientData> passiveClients, Controller controller, AsyncRunner dispatcher, Game model) throws Exception
      Handles the logic for a new leader scenario, or concludes the game if a final ranking is available. This method is called when the game needs to determine a new leader or if the game has ended due to the deck being empty. It dispatches updates to both active and passive clients.
      Parameters:
      activeClients - A map of active client UUIDs to their ClientData.
      passiveClients - A map of passive client UUIDs to their ClientData.
      controller - The game Controller instance.
      dispatcher - The AsyncRunner used for asynchronous task execution to clients.
      model - The current Game model.
      Throws:
      Exception - If an error occurs during client communication or model manipulation.
